metadata.description: Agent skills that generate the operator-attested ConfigMaps consumed by trivy-plugin-vdr for FedRAMP VDR/VER: cluster dataflow capture (internet-reachability taint graph) and asset-archetype/Class attestations.

plugins.name: trivy-plugin-vdr-skills
plugins.description: Two skills for FedRAMP VDR/VER evidence generation with trivy-plugin-vdr: capture-dataflow analyzes NetworkPolicies, service-mesh authorization resources, optional Hubble/mesh flow exports, and workload env/Secret/ConfigMap declarations (in that order of preference, with a sufficiency evaluation after each stage) to produce the vdr-dataflow ConfigMap and per-namespace Mermaid dataflow diagrams; generate-vdr-configmap interviews the operator (Certification Class with FedRAMP level mapping, agency scope, asset-archetype attestations) to produce the vdr-fedramp scoring ConfigMap. Artifacts are saved locally for review and applied by the operator (kubectl or GitOps) — the skills never modify the cluster.
